arguments.prompt: Medium shot with a long lens of a mauve fabric banner hanging between the limestone columns of a semicircular portico, filling the frame width, in flat grey overcast light with a fine drizzle falling. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. The only movement: the fabric, heavy with rain, hangs almost perfectly still - at most a barely visible breath along its lower edge - while drops gather and run off its bottom hem; no fold ever lifts, no part of the banner curls or turns over, every word stays fully visible, perfectly legible and undistorted for the whole shot. Nothing else moves; the stone is fixed. No people. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: flat overcast daylight, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
